positive_controls: three uniquely staged task instances and nonoverlapping probe sets survive request archiving
first acquisition record is selected after five newer unrelated history records
transfer outcome returns through canonical World-State and ordinary writeback
third task staging requires and finds at least two admitted family records
all family source facts remain absent from current evidence in present/withheld/restored conditions
progression reports exact same model/generation controls and fixture-only posture

implementation.durable_requests: Each episode is staged with its exact request identity and retained through the existing bounded immutable archive.
implementation.episode_chain: The first scored family outcome enters World-State and ordinary admitted history. A later held-out task score is then projected back to World-State, admitted through the same writeback owner, and used to preregister a third disjoint probe suite.
implementation.leakage: Task-family source facts present in the World-State are excluded from every condition current-evidence projection. The score/report contains counts and receipt identities, not oracle parameters or answer text.
implementation.measurement: The owner progression view verifies three exact task/run/receipt identities, reports chronological episodes and the same exact fixture model/generation controls, and explicitly states that performance improvement and learning are not established.

objective: Compose acquisition, transferred outcome, feedback writeback, and a further distinct held-out task into a measurable three-episode fixture progression.
